<div class="card-body">
'''Imperial Walker''' is a [[Dark]] [[Vehicle]] from [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy|Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy]].

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">インペリアル・ウォーカー</span><ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">1名のパイロットと8名の乗客を搭乗させられる。能力値1の専属パイロットが搭乗している。</span><ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">4本足の密閉型戦闘用ビークル。巨体を揺るがせて迫り来るＡＴ－ＡＴ（全地形対応装甲トランスポート）は、完全武装の兵員をまるまる1個大隊、輸送することができる。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Imperial Walker.

'''Card text:''' May carry one pilot and eight passengers. A permanent pilot of ability 1 is aboard.

'''Lore:''' Four-legged enclosed combat vehicle. The looming AT-AT (All Terrain Armored Transport) can carry an entire battalion of fully armed soldiers.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore says battalion where the English lore says squadron.
<h2>Notes</h2>
'''Imperial Walker (Japanese Reflections II Foil)''' is a Japanese-language foil printing of [[Imperial Walker|Imperial Walker]]. [[Decipher]] released it in [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy]] in January 2001. The ordinary Japanese expansion printing is [[Imperial Walker (Japanese ESB Two-Player)]]. Complete Card List v4 lists checklist R49 at rarity SR. Collector R-numbers are checklist references, not GEMP blueprint IDs.<ref name="checklist">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Complete Card List v4.0], p. 30, Reflections II foil cards, R49. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009184033/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 21. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Imperial-Walker-Reflections-II-Foil-SWCA.jpg|Original Japanese foil face]]. Photograph by Duncan Jenkins.</ref>
